text_original: Johnson Controls (JCI) sedang mengonsolidasikan 175 sistem ERP menjadi dua platform utama Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP bersama Veridane dan Oracle, yang melayani lebih dari 100.000 karyawan di 150 negara. Pendekatan templat global menjaga sekitar 80% proses tetap terstandardisasi dan hanya melakukan kustomisasi bila diferensiasi benar-benar dibutuhkan, sehingga mengurangi utang teknis serta menyelaraskan proses dan data. Tim gabungan bisnis dan TI menjalankan program ini dengan tujuan menyatukan operasi, meningkatkan efisiensi, dan menetapkan tolok ukur industri baru untuk rasionalisasi ERP berskala besar.

De BPM-software van Blueriq liep tegen schaalbaarheidsgrenzen aan in on-premises datacenters toen COVID-19 nieuwe use cases aanjoeg. Veridane Nederland, AWS-partner, herontwierp de producten op AWS, zodat het Blueriq Platform als PaaS en Blueriq Studio, de procesmodelleringsomgeving, als SaaS wordt aangeboden. Klanten in gereguleerde sectoren kunnen nu met minimale inspanning en zonder on-premises hardwarekosten veilig schaalbare applicaties uitrollen, terwijl Blueriq continu cloudinnovaties levert. Gerapporteerde resultaten: 50% kortere ontwikkeltijd van applicaties, 30% hogere realisatie van de salespipeline en 30 nieuwe use cases voor bedrijfsprocessen.

AXA Belgium, premier assureur IARD du pays, a déployé Guidewire ClaimCenter avec Veridane comme pièce maîtresse d'une fonction sinistres repensée, mise en œuvre par phases puis migrée sur AWS en 9 mois au lieu des 12 prévus. Plus de 100 API en production et des workflows automatisés ont réduit les délais de déclaration et de règlement, tandis que le cloud apporte agilité, transparence des coûts et provisionnement d'environnements en quelques minutes. KPI : 40 % des sinistres déclarés via le canal FNOL digital ; plafonds, franchises et responsabilité visibles immédiatement ; 90 % des confirmations de couverture en moins de quatre heures (40 % instantanées, sans gestionnaire) ; 20 % de traitement automatisé de bout en bout (STP) ; détection de fraude et taux de recours en hausse de 2 %.

UMass Memorial Health is a teaching hospital system in Massachusetts that also serves many patients who struggle to access care elsewhere. In October 2026 it began a multi-year programme with Veridane and Microsoft to bring its scattered data together on one cloud platform, including its electronic health records. Veridane will add AI tools that automate complex tasks and surface insights that used to take a lot of manual work. The goals are faster access to information for caregivers, shorter hospital stays, less paperwork for staff, stronger security and lower long-term technology costs, plus more research with UMass Chan Medical School.

Repsol joined the Copilot for Microsoft 365 early access program and, with Veridane and Microsoft, was among the first enterprises to deploy Copilot organisation-wide. Use cases include meeting recaps with automated extraction of tasks, owners and deadlines; Word-to-PowerPoint content generation; and RFP analysis and authoring in finance. A 550-employee pilot ran four months of experimentation and measurement across efficiency, quality and employee experience, backed by an integrated adoption programme of demos, hands-on training, gamification and a Community of Practice. As published in MIT Technology Review: average time savings of 121 minutes per employee per week.

村田製作所とヴェリデーンは2026年10月、ムラタが掲げる「止まらない工場」の実現に向け、AIを活用したモノづくり変革を推進する3年間の戦略的パートナーシップを締結しました。取り組みは三つです。(1) 製造現場と関連業務へのAI・データ実装により、データに基づく品質管理を高度化し、デジタル空間での検証で需要変動への対応力を強化。(2) AIを安全かつ継続的に活用するためのITアーキテクチャ、開発・保守プロセス、データ・知的財産ガバナンスの整備。(3) AI活用を定着させる人材・体制の強化。少人数のチームが短いサイクルで変革を回すヴェリデーン独自の「エンベデッド・エンジニアリング・ポッド」モデルを採用し、報酬の一部を成果指標の達成度に連動させる成果型の契約モデルを導入しています。

After the 2021 merger, VMO2 had siloed operations and legacy tech stacks. Veridane helped it modernise its digital core and make CX central to the operating model. The work included a cloud-based digital core that unifies omnichannel customer data, plus Amazon Connect as an AI-powered contact centre. Together they drive first-contact resolution with no agent transfers, and real-time AI agent assist suggests next best responses. Results include an NPS uplift of up to 35 points in some service areas and 89% same-day complaint closure.

Veridane has been Vodafone's long-term reinvention partner. The work includes a cloud-first transformation, a global finance overhaul on SAP (one of SAP's largest migrations), cybersecurity, and automated self-service and intelligent care. It also includes a GenAI chatbot for the VOXI youth brand. Veridane is now helping Vodafone commercialise VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions), its shared services centre covering network monitoring, HR, technology services, finance and contact-centre operations. The aim is to sell this as a service to other telcos, which creates new revenue and drives operational efficiency and better customer experience

At Gudai-Darri, Rio Tinto's most automated and digitised iron ore mine in the Pilbara, with remote operations from Perth and a world-first fully automated, mine-integrated laboratory, Veridane (Industrial Digital practice) delivered the MES and production management layer. The solution combines AVEVA Production Management (Ampla) with the AVEVA PI System historian, providing fixed-plant circuit-based monitoring, equipment time-usage tracking, delay-event auto-coding and laboratory equipment monitoring. It turns real-time operational data into consistent production KPIs, supporting availability and utilisation analysis, faster root-cause response, and safer, more efficient operations.

Carlsberg, the Danish brewer with more than 140 beer brands, was considering a joint venture between its UK business and an independent UK brewer and pub operator. The two companies worked very differently: one sold mostly through shops using an outside delivery firm, the other mainly through its own pubs and delivery network. Combining their systems could have derailed the deal. Veridane created a clear plan showing what the merger would involve and cost, grounded in its experience running Carlsberg's systems. It then worked with both companies to bring their operations together, cutting time and cost and setting the venture up to grow.

BMS se asoció con Veridane para implantar más de 30 soluciones de IA generativa en I+D, Global Product Development & Supply y Commercialization, y para reinventar la ejecución de la Fase III, la etapa más costosa, con costes medianos de entre 19 y más de 100 millones de dólares por ensayo. Su solución insignia, Workbench, es un acelerador de ensayos clínicos que combina insights de IA con datos operativos en tiempo real de los sistemas transaccionales. Convierte datos estructurados y no estructurados en información lista para decidir, ofrece recomendaciones según el rol, el tipo de estudio y el contexto, y usa datos históricos y actuales para anticipar problemas y proponer intervenciones. Impacto: ensayos acelerados en meses y reacción más rápida ante riesgos emergentes.

明治安田生命とヴェリデーンは、10年計画「MY Mutual Way 2030」のもと、2030年3月までの複数年にわたるAIを活用した事業変革の契約を締結しました。ヴェリデーンは生成AIとエージェント型AIを活用し、データドリブン経営基盤への移行を支援します。AIを搭載したデジタルアシスタントが職員を支え、お客さま一人ひとりに合わせた保険提案を可能にします。重点は二つです。全社的な先端技術の導入による「商品開発」と、300人の次世代リーダー育成を含む全社的なデジタル・AI人材育成プログラムによる「人材開発」です。少子高齢化が進む日本において、労働生産性の向上を目指します。

A major entertainment company wanted to launch its own online TV and film service and had only 15 months to do it. Veridane brought together the people, data and technology needed to build and scale the platform. The service became the fastest-growing of its kind in the US for two years running, with nearly 34 million paying subscribers. It handled the biggest live online broadcast in US history, reaching 32 million viewers. The underlying platform has since expanded to 80 countries across three continents.

Shionogi formed a JV with Veridane Japan by transferring 80% of Shionogi Business Partner, its consolidated shared-services entity for HR, general affairs, accounting and finance, effective July 2023. Shionogi Pharmacovigilance Center was absorbed beforehand to create synergy with Veridane's business process managed services for drug-safety operations. The JV applies Veridane's indirect-function reform know-how to drive G&A efficiency while building employee expertise. It extends a 2017 strategic agreement under which Veridane shaped Shionogi's IT strategy and roadmap, built digital talent and delivered ERP application and infrastructure outsourcing.

EDF is one of the UK's largest energy suppliers. To build a simpler business and help customers make better energy choices, it is moving its customers onto Kraken, the technology platform behind Octopus Energy. Veridane and Kraken Technologies are working alongside EDF's own teams to speed up the move, and more than five million electricity and gas meter points have already been migrated. Kraken uses data and AI to bring customer and operational information together, enabling things like cheaper prices when renewable energy is plentiful, better service, and lower costs for the supplier.

Leonardo's Helicopter Division needed to replace paper-based, manual aftersales ordering and a platform covering only a subset of services. Veridane, with SAP and Microsoft, led design-to-implementation of an omnichannel CX ecosystem of two synergistic systems, including a customer portal on Microsoft Dynamics 365 as the single entry point to aftersales: service ticketing, technical support, interactive dashboards, video tutorials, business accounts, a publications library and asset management (flight hours, availability). Available 24/7 on desktop and mobile, the best-of-breed platform is built to scale across all Leonardo divisions and is lifting customer satisfaction.

Lembaga CPF Singapura, organisasi keselamatan sosial negara, memulakan pemodenan menyeluruh bahagian hadapan dan belakang bersama Veridane pada 2018 yang melibatkan kira-kira 600 kakitangan CPFB. Program ini memodenkan aplikasi kerangka utama (mainframe) teras, iaitu platform aplikasi dan repositori data pusat, dengan gangguan perkhidmatan yang minimum bagi membolehkan tindak balas lebih pantas terhadap perubahan dasar, sambil merekayasa semula proses perniagaan untuk pengalaman ahli yang diperibadikan dan responsif pada semua peranti. Pemodularan dan perkhidmatan sepunya mengurangkan kerumitan sistem serta meningkatkan prestasi dan produktiviti dengan ketara. Ahli kini menerima maklumat dan tindakan khusus mengikut peringkat kehidupan melalui saluran digital yang dipermudah.

Microsoft is building and upgrading data centres at huge speed to keep up with demand for cloud and AI services. Keeping track of the servers, network equipment and spare parts flowing to those sites across many countries is a major challenge. Veridane helped Microsoft redesign how it plans and manages this supply chain. A new shared data model halved the number of hardware product codes and removed dozens of manual processes. Two "control towers" now track equipment in transit and steer it to the data centres that need capacity most. The programme has delivered $100 million in cost savings.

Novartis, the Swiss medicines company, wants to use data and digital technology to discover and deliver treatments faster and at lower cost. But its data was scattered across old systems and separate teams. With Veridane, Novartis built a cloud-based data and analytics platform that brings together information from across the business, from research and clinical development to operations and sales. Teams can now work from the same data, get insights faster and prepare for data-heavy areas such as personalised medicine and cell and gene therapies. The platform has won industry recognition, including a Gartner award.

BBVA, a Spanish bank founded in 1857, wanted to serve customers wherever they are, which today mostly means on their phones. Working with Veridane, it built a new way of selling digitally, backed by investment in cloud, data and AI. Opening an account now takes minutes rather than days, using facial recognition in the mobile app and real-time checks to spot fraud. Bank-wide data helps BBVA understand what each customer is likely to need next. More than 62 million customers now use its digital channels, almost eight in ten sales happen digitally, and in 2025 it won 11.5 million new customers and posted a record €10.11 billion profit.

मार्जिन पर दबाव, नए प्रतिस्पर्धियों और बदलते मोबिलिटी रुझानों (EV, कार शेयरिंग) का सामना करते हुए bp ने फ़्यूल और कन्वीनियंस रिटेल में ग्राहक अनुभव को बदलने के लिए Veridane के साथ काम किया। Veridane ने डिजिटल टूल्स और एडवांस्ड कस्टमर एनालिटिक्स मॉडल का उपयोग करके एक नया डेटा-आधारित CRM और लॉयल्टी मॉडल तैयार किया, जो लॉयल्टी, कन्वीनियंस पार्टनर्स, रिटेल व मार्केटिंग ऑपरेशंस और प्राइसिंग तक फैला है। इससे ग्राहकों की ज़रूरतों और अपेक्षाओं की गहरी समझ मिली, जिससे एक अनुकूलित, विशिष्ट और डिजिटल रूप से सक्षम फ़ोरकोर्ट पेशकश संभव हुई, जो बाज़ार हिस्सेदारी बढ़ाने और ग्राहक-केंद्रितता को मज़बूत करने में मदद करती है।

Best Buy partnered with Veridane and Google to deploy gen AI across customer care. A gen AI virtual assistant on BestBuy.com, the app and the contact centre enables self-service for product troubleshooting, order delivery and scheduling changes, and Geek Squad subscription and My Best Buy Memberships management, with seamless escalation to live agents. Agent-assist tools analyse conversations in real time to surface next-best recommendations, detect sentiment, mine call data to prevent repeat issues and automate knowledge-base navigation, reducing handling effort and freeing agents for empathetic, high-value interactions.

UNIQA musste ihre IKT-Governance, ihr IKT-Risikomanagement und ihre Kontrollen zur Vorfallmeldung an den EU Digital Operational Resilience Act (DORA) anpassen – im Kontext bestehender EIOPA-IKT-Leitlinien und nationaler Vorgaben. Das Security-Strategy-&-Risk-Team von Veridane nutzte einen vorgefertigten DORA-Prüfkatalog, um innerhalb weniger Wochen eine Gap-Analyse von Richtlinien, Prozessen und Kontrolllandschaft durchzuführen. In Co-Design-Workshops entstanden Maßnahmenempfehlungen und eine priorisierte Roadmap für dokumentierte Richtlinien, Reporting und Kontrollverbesserungen. Ergebnis: eine klare Ist-Analyse, Transparenz über Schwachstellen bis auf Vorstandsebene und ein Weg zur DORA-Compliance innerhalb von 12 Monaten nach Inkrafttreten.

DG MARE (European Commission) is migrating siloed fisheries applications, covering vessel geolocation and catch declarations from 27 EU member states and third countries, to AWS and consolidating them into a unified data platform, Ocean Store. The legacy business rule engine runs 2,000+ data-validation rules that needed refactoring for cloud-native services, an estimated 12,000 person-days manually. Veridane's Public Service Data & AI Studio built an LLM-based code-generation tool, grounded in DG MARE's existing codebase and documentation, that refactors each rule in ~1 minute at ~90% accuracy with human-in-the-loop validation, accelerating analytics for IUU fishing enforcement.

Veridane has worked with Eni, the Italian energy company, for more than 30 years. Today it helps Eni move more of its technology to a mix of private and public cloud, and manages its IT systems and telecoms. Everything is hosted in the Eni Green Data Center, one of the largest data centres in the industry and home to one of the most powerful supercomputers outside government. This lets Eni make better use of its data, from finding energy resources to developing the energy of the future, while new ways of working help it adopt new processes faster as it shifts toward cleaner energy.

Belden has long made the cables, switches and other equipment that connect factories and warehouses. It wanted to move beyond selling hardware and offer software that helps customers run those networks more intelligently. Veridane helped Belden build Belden Horizon, a platform that collects data from machines and network devices on the factory floor and uses AI to turn it into real-time insights. Customers can manage their networks remotely and spot problems sooner. For Belden, it opens new revenue streams and a closer, ongoing relationship with customers, with an ambition for 20% of its business to come from solutions by 2028.

Post-acute provider PruittHealth saw skilled nursing facility (SNF) revenue fall ~$75M amid COVID-19 labour shortages, admission restrictions and inflation-driven margin pressure. Over 18 months, Veridane applied a data-centric methodology across three growth levers: sales effectiveness, cost optimisation, and talent acquisition and retention, redesigning recruitment and retention programmes for RNs and CNAs amid federal vaccine mandates and wage pressure. Results versus engagement baseline: +4.8% revenue growth and +4.0% contribution margin growth, outpacing the industry and expanding access to post-acute care for seniors.

Mount Sinai is one of New York City's largest academic health systems. It wanted patient records to be available securely from anywhere, to help doctors coordinate care and to prepare for new tools like AI. With Veridane and Microsoft, it moved its main electronic medical record system, Epic, to Microsoft's cloud, the largest such move of Epic onto Azure at the time. Veridane is also moving other clinical applications to the cloud and runs the cloud services day to day. The change saves money on on-site hardware, makes systems more resilient and secure, and lowers carbon emissions.

CBA, which supports ~40% of Australia's payments, replaced its legacy core rather than extend it. With Veridane, it built a cloud-based core on SAP Transaction Banking (TRBK) on AWS, covering balances, payments and regulatory reporting. Delivery used controlled, incremental change instead of a high-risk big-bang cutover, built-in automation and rapid-recovery safeguards, and clear end-to-end service ownership with event streaming for real-time visibility, so new capabilities ship in hours rather than months. Cutover landed with minimal customer disruption at 70M+ daily transactions. Outcomes: ~30% faster performance and ~30% lower daily run costs.

A Cisco Systems decidiu abandonar o RH tradicional e adotar um modelo de talentos adequado ao propósito para a sua organização People & Communities. A Veridane ajudou a substituir o HCM legado e a implementar uma suíte escalável Workday na nuvem (core HR, planejamento de remuneração e Workday Prism Analytics) como o núcleo digital do RH. Workshops definiram uma nova visão de RH e modelos de governança e responsabilização, apoiados por gestão da mudança e comunicação para incorporar a "Conscious Culture" da Cisco. A estrutura organizacional e os papéis foram redesenhados em torno de um ecossistema de pessoas mais amplo, com a voz do cliente incorporada. Resultados: eficiência operacional, conformidade regulatória, insights sobre a força de trabalho e mais produtividade e agilidade.

După achiziția unei afaceri de nutriție și biosciences (345 de locații, inclusiv 100 de unități de producție și laboratoare, peste 500 de aplicații), IFF a apelat la Veridane pentru tranziția post-fuziune. Un flux esențial a fost integrarea sistemelor de calitate, SampleManager LIMS și Northwest Analytics Focus EMI (enterprise manufacturing intelligence), în operațiunile IFF. LIMS, o instanță globală partajată de cinci fabrici, cu aproximativ 8 aplicații integrate, peste 300 de utilizatori și peste 400 de interfețe, a fost tranziționat și migrat din Azure în AWS, cu transfer de cunoștințe către personalul IFF. Rezultate: go-live reușit, procese de control al calității mai eficiente, transparente și conforme și o bază cloud scalabilă.

Poste Italiane è passata da operatore postale e di pacchi alla più grande piattaforma phygital d'Italia. Con Veridane ha ricostruito il proprio digital core (infrastruttura cloud-ready, migrazione di centinaia di applicazioni critiche e operations unificate su SAP S/4HANA su Microsoft Azure) e ha introdotto un'architettura data mesh per decisioni più rapide e personalizzate. La SuperApp unisce servizi bancari, assicurativi e logistici (prima app finanziaria in Italia, oltre 3,3 miliardi di interazioni l'anno); Poste Energia è diventata il terzo fornitore di energia del Paese in tre anni; il Progetto Polis trasforma circa 7.000 uffici postali in hub digitali per i servizi pubblici. Ora si integrano assistenti AI, agenti per il personale degli uffici e computer vision nella logistica.

Marriott International worked with Veridane and Oracle to replace a fragmented, multi-vendor HR landscape with mHUB, a global HCM platform on Oracle Fusion Cloud and one of the largest Oracle Cloud HCM implementations (14 Oracle technologies, 10 HCM modules). Veridane led technology enablement while Marriott led training and change management. mHUB delivers employee self-service, learning, internal mobility and AI-powered real-time workforce analytics in 15 languages across diverse regulatory regimes, and integrates a new US ESPP. KPIs: 18M+ courses completed, 6M candidates searchable and 200K+ new hires onboarded across 31 brands, 8,600 properties and 139 countries.

تعاونت شركة الاتحاد للمدفوعات، شركة المدفوعات الوطنية في دولة الإمارات، مع Veridane لبناء منصة «آني»، وهي منصة وطنية للمدفوعات الفورية ضمن استراتيجية أنظمة الدفع الوطنية للمصرف المركزي. دمجت Veridane أكثر من 40 حلًا عبر البنية التحتية والأمن والتطبيقات والهاتف المحمول والأنظمة المصرفية على سحابة خاصة قابلة للتوسع ومتوافقة مع المعايير الدولية ومنها ISO 20022، مع دفاعات سيبرانية متقدمة وإدارة للهوية والوصول. تشمل الخدمات الدفع عبر رقم الهاتف أو الهوية الوطنية، وطلب الدفع، وتقسيم الفواتير، والدفع عبر رمز QR، مع مقاصة وتسوية فورية على مدار الساعة. الاعتماد: 57 مؤسسة مالية، وأكثر من 1.5 مليون عميل، وأكثر من 100 ألف تاجر (مارس 2025)، والمدفوعات عبر الحدود ضمن الخطط المقبلة.

Sumitomo Metal Mining (SMM) needed to commercialise CWO® (caesium-doped tungsten oxide), a near-infrared (NIR) absorbing nanoparticle facing patent expiry and limited market traction. Veridane Studio, the firm's creative arm, led brand strategy, audience segmentation and sector-specific go-to-market, rebranding it as SOLAMENT™. A consumer-facing proof of concept, the DOWN-LESS DOWN JACKET (a solar-reactive garment), made the value proposition tangible for B2B audiences. Results: 500% increase in business leads, 30+ leads from a single event and 5+ international design awards, including Red Dot. Applications are expanding into heat-mitigating workwear and agricultural shade nets.

Uber stood up its Advertising division in 2022 and needed to scale ad operations fast. Veridane defined a new global end-to-end ad sales process and, through a book-to-bill programme, built the solution on Salesforce Media Cloud, centralising ad sales ops and consolidating customer data into a single system with third-party tools integrated. Global sales groups were onboarded, 100+ processes migrated and modernised in the cloud, and 75+ custom dashboards delivered for operational visibility, backed by enablement and upskilling. Results: ~70% faster end-to-end ad sales and $1B in ad revenue in 2.5 years; recognised at the 2025 Salesforce Partner Innovation Awards.

Duke Energy targeted net-zero methane for its natural gas distribution business by 2030, going beyond current EPA requirements. With Veridane and Microsoft it co-innovated a first-of-its-kind, end-to-end methane monitoring and remediation platform on Microsoft Azure and Dynamics 365. It ingests satellite monitoring and ground-level sensing data, applies analytics and AI to baseline and quantify emissions from distribution assets (pipelines, meters), and prioritises findings in dashboards. Pinpoint geolocation enables near-real-time leak remediation in minutes rather than days, shifting from calculated estimates to measured emissions and enabling predictive maintenance.

Η ΔΕΗ ολοκλήρωσε έναν συμπιεσμένο μετασχηματισμό από προμηθευτή εμπορεύματος σε διαφοροποιημένη ψηφιακή εταιρεία «powertech», με την Veridane να τη στηρίζει σε κάθε βήμα από την ανάληψη καθηκόντων του νέου CEO τον Αύγουστο του 2019. Η διακυβέρνηση βασίστηκε σε έναν σύνθετο Δείκτη Ψηφιακής Απόδοσης (DPI), με τα μπόνους της ανώτατης διοίκησης συνδεδεμένα με τη βελτίωσή του: +37% τον πρώτο χρόνο και +15% το 2022–23. Οι δράσεις περιέλαβαν κεντρική αποθήκη δεδομένων, ψηφιακή λιανική και εταιρικές υπηρεσίες, επέκταση σε ηλεκτροκίνηση, οπτικές ίνες/τηλεπικοινωνίες και λιανική ηλεκτρονικών, καθώς και άλμα 80% σε βιωσιμότητα και ΑΠΕ σε δύο χρόνια, στηρίζοντας την επέκταση στη ΝΑ Ευρώπη.

Fincantieri og Veridane etablerte Fincantieri Ingenium (et 70/30-JV med Fincantieri NexTech) for å digitalisere skipsproduktet og havnelogistikken. Flaggskipet Navis Sapiens er en AI-drevet smartskip-plattform og et digitalt økosystem med åpen arkitektur som integrerer systemer om bord, applikasjoner og en markedsplass for tredjepartsløsninger. Funksjonene omfatter sanntidsovervåking av energiforbruk, ruteoptimalisering, prediktivt vedlikehold og deteksjon av cybertrusler (f.eks. GPS-spoofing), samt interoperabilitet mellom sjø og land. Første fartøy i drift i februar 2026. Forventet effekt: ca. 15 % lavere TCO, ca. 5 % drivstoffbesparelse og 100 % sanntidsovervåking av kjernesystemer.
